reason: Generic runtime schemas do not own Plite grammar, root fitting, property lifecycle, identities, or migrations.
reopen_condition: Reopen only for a concrete interop caller the compiled editor schema cannot serve.

reason: HTML, Markdown, DOCX, persistence, clipboard, CSV, and text have incompatible laws and result data.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if one current caller needs one truthful law across every included format.

reason: A read/write capability object adds indirection without shared lifecycle or polymorphic callers.
reopen_condition: Reopen when runtime format selection becomes a real public caller.

reason: Format extras, locations, cancellation, and failure modes differ; a shared result erases useful precision.
reopen_condition: Reopen only for fields and semantics all formats actually share.

reason: A universal AST moves format loss into adapters and duplicates the editor model.
reopen_condition: Reopen for a second independent transform that cannot use source or editor model directly.

reason: No caller needs to manage compilation/session lifetime; one-shot functions and editor delegates can keep it private.
reopen_condition: Reopen after measured repeated conversion proves a caller-controlled prepared target.

reason: No current caller benefits from duplicating assertDocument diagnostics into a Zod-shaped wrapper.
reopen_condition: Reopen when a named caller must branch without exceptions and cannot catch EditorSchemaValidationError.

reason: One-way validation interop has no current Plate consumer and does not solve conversion loss.
reopen_condition: Reopen for an actual ecosystem integration.

reason: Source retention needs format-specific correspondence and invalidation.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if two formats share identical retained-source lifetime and operations.

reason: One location cannot truthfully address both encoded source and fitted editor model.
reopen_condition: Never reopen without a mapping that preserves both coordinate spaces.

reason: Stress parsing retained hundreds of MB per isolated Window and repeatedly OOMed at 4 GB.
reopen_condition: Reopen only after upstream evidence and Plate rerun meet the frozen memory budget.

reason: LinkeDOM alone does not implement browser-equivalent tree construction for malformed fragments.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if conformance becomes equivalent to parse5/browser on the Plate corpus.

reason: DOCX export needs configured static rendering and current adopted editor capture; symmetry is not a caller.
reopen_condition: Reopen for a detached saved-document export caller with full rendering configuration.

reason: fitDocument changes input and therefore cannot be validation.
reopen_condition: Never reopen unless behavior becomes rejection-only.

reason: Synchronous in-memory HTML and Markdown do not have an interruptible async phase.
reopen_condition: Reopen if the implementation becomes async or resource-bound.

reason: Raw arrays discard open boundaries and secondary roots already represented by ContentSlice.
reopen_condition: Never reopen while ContentSlice is the insertion carrier.
